title: 皮克斯风格角色表
prompt: A character sheet of [detailed description of thecharacter], in the style of Pixar, featuring multiple poses and expressions from different angles, including concept art, pencil sketches, a full-body reference sheet, and a white background. The sheet includes wide shots, low-angle views, 3D renders, and Octane renderings, highly detailed result.
description: 使用Nano Banana Pro轻松生成皮克斯风格角色表，适用于动画工作室和游戏开发，提供多角度动态姿势与高细节3D渲染参考。Nano Banana Pro则能快速创建概念艺术和全身参考图，帮助专业设计师高效完成角色设计。
